Google model-viewer 4.4.0, official self-contained browser distribution.
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/model-viewer/v/4.4.0
Upstream: https://github.com/google/model-viewer
Distributed locally to load only on AR request, with its bundled Three.js version
isolated from the simulator renderer. License retained alongside this file and
in the distribution's license comments. Do not substitute the package's unbundled entry.
